name: alexa-mcp
description: Amazon Alexa for Claude — Echo devices, announcements, routines, smart home, lists and alarms via natural language

alexa_registration.title: Alexa registration (optional)
alexa_registration.description: Optional. Leave blank to use the state file written by `npx @chrischall/alexa-mcp login`. To set it here, run that command with --print and paste the line it prints.

tools.name: alexa_healthcheck
tools.description: Check that Amazon still accepts the Alexa session (device-list probe)

tools.name: alexa_session_status
tools.description: Report how the server is configured — registration source, Amazon site, cookie age (no network)

tools.name: alexa_begin_login
tools.description: Start signing in to Amazon — returns a link to open in your own browser

tools.name: alexa_finish_login
tools.description: Finish signing in with the address of the page Amazon sends you to

tools.name: alexa_list_devices
tools.description: List Echo speakers, Echo Shows, Fire TVs and other Alexa devices with online status

tools.name: alexa_get_now_playing
tools.description: What is playing on an Alexa device right now

tools.name: alexa_list_volumes
tools.description: Current volume and mute state of each Alexa device

tools.name: alexa_set_volume
tools.description: Set an Alexa device volume (asks you to confirm first)

tools.name: alexa_playback
tools.description: Play, pause, next or previous on an Alexa device (asks you to confirm first)

tools.name: alexa_speak
tools.description: Speak or announce text on Alexa devices (asks you to confirm first)

tools.name: alexa_list_routines
tools.description: List Alexa routines with their triggers

tools.name: alexa_run_routine
tools.description: Run an Alexa routine now (asks you to confirm first)

tools.name: alexa_list_smart_home
tools.description: List thermostats, lights, plugs, locks, garage doors and scenes Alexa controls

tools.name: alexa_control_smart_home
tools.description: Turn a smart-home device on/off, set brightness or colour, or activate a scene (asks you to confirm first)

tools.name: alexa_list_lists
tools.description: List Alexa shopping and to-do lists

tools.name: alexa_get_list_items
tools.description: Read the items on an Alexa list

tools.name: alexa_add_list_item
tools.description: Add an item to an Alexa list (asks you to confirm first)

tools.name: alexa_remove_list_item
tools.description: Delete an item from an Alexa list (asks you to confirm first)

tools.name: alexa_list_alarms_reminders
tools.description: List alarms, timers and reminders on Alexa devices

tools.name: alexa_get_smart_home_state
tools.description: Read thermostat temperature and setpoints, light and plug state, locks and sensors

tools.name: alexa_set_thermostat
tools.description: Set a thermostat temperature or mode (asks you to confirm first)

tools.name: alexa_set_vacation_mode
tools.description: Turn thermostat vacation (away) mode on or off — saves and restores settings (asks you to confirm first)

tools.name: alexa_get_do_not_disturb
tools.description: Which Alexa devices have Do Not Disturb on

tools.name: alexa_set_do_not_disturb
tools.description: Turn Do Not Disturb on or off for a device (asks you to confirm first)

tools.name: alexa_get_equalizer
tools.description: Read an Echo speaker’s bass, mid and treble

tools.name: alexa_set_equalizer
tools.description: Set an Echo speaker’s bass, mid and treble (asks you to confirm first)

tools.name: alexa_create_reminder
tools.description: Set a reminder or alarm on an Echo device (asks you to confirm first)

tools.name: alexa_create_timer
tools.description: Start a countdown timer on an Echo device (asks you to confirm first)

tools.name: alexa_cancel_alarm_reminder
tools.description: Delete an alarm, timer or reminder (asks you to confirm first)

tools.name: alexa_list_bluetooth
tools.description: Bluetooth devices paired with each Alexa device

tools.name: alexa_run_builtin
tools.description: Play weather, news, a joke, calendar and other built-ins out loud (asks you to confirm first)

tools.name: alexa_fire_tv
tools.description: Turn a Fire TV on/off, pause, resume or go home (asks you to confirm first)

tools.name: alexa_stop
tools.description: Stop music, alarms or speech on one or every device (asks you to confirm first)

tools.name: alexa_update_list_item
tools.description: Check off or un-check an Alexa list item (asks you to confirm first)

tools.name: alexa_list_device_modes
tools.description: List a device’s mode settings (fan mode, vacuum mode) and their values

tools.name: alexa_set_device_mode
tools.description: Change a device mode such as thermostat fan mode (asks you to confirm first)

tools.name: alexa_garage_door
tools.description: Open or close a garage door (asks you to confirm first)

tools.name: alexa_lock
tools.description: Lock or unlock a smart lock (asks you to confirm first)
